extractedItems.title: What happens if you tee off in the wrong order?
extractedItems.question: You're playing in a competition and accidentally tee off before it's your turn. What happens to your score?

choices.text: You have to replay your shot with a penalty stroke.
Your shot counts and there is no penalty.
You are disqualified from the hole.
You must replay your shot, but no penalty.

extractedItems.explanation: Teeing off out of order is not penalised unless done for tactical advantage.

extractedItems.title: Defining the teeing area
extractedItems.question: Where must the ball be when you play your first shot from the teeing area?

choices.text: Anywhere within 2 club-lengths of the markers, even if your stance is outside.
On the line between the tee markers.
Entirely inside the teeing area, which is between the tee markers and up to 2 club-lengths behind them.
Anywhere, as long as your feet are inside the teeing area.

extractedItems.explanation: The ball must be entirely inside the teeing area, but you may take your stance outside it.

extractedItems.question: What is the penalty if you play your tee shot from outside the teeing area and you don't correct it?

choices.text: You get no penalty, your shot counts.
You must replay your shot with 2 penalty strokes.
